BBOX was exploited on BNB Chain on 5 December 2022 through spot price manipulation. The attacker distorted AMM prices via a flash loan to profit from token swaps. No official loss figure was published, and the incident relied on easily manipulated spot prices without protective checks. BBOX trusted manipulable spot prices from AMM pools for settlement logic. This allowed attackers to use flash loans and large swaps within a single transaction to distort token price and extract value. There were no resistance measures such as time-weighted oracles or deviation bounds.
